cluster: rhombic torus of 18 x 18 three-site unit cells, edge vectors 18 a1 and 18 a2 (a1, a2 the triangular Bravais vectors, 60 degrees apart), the pattern of kagome-8x8_192_P and kagome-10x10_300_P. Defined by arXiv:2008.07829: 'The calculation is done on a L x L x 3 cluster' (Sec. III A; L = 18 is its largest converged cluster), with N = 3L^2 in arXiv:2611.05174 Table II. The spin Hamiltonian is periodic; 'periodic - anti-periodic boundary condition' is that of the fermionic state before projection

verified.note: Table II of arXiv:2611.05174 (Supplemental Material, 'Variational energy density of the optimized Z2* reference state reported in Ref. [6]'), row L = 18, N = 3L^2 = 972, column E_Z2*/N; the main text prints -0.428783(1) for L = 8 as the Z2 projected mean-field VMC value of the same reference; Ref. [6] there is Zhang & Li (PRB 102, 195106). The local arXiv text of 2008.07829 (Sept 2020) prints no table, only Fig. 5 (U(1) and Z2 energy against L, error bar smaller than the symbol), whose points agree with the Table II values to the figure's resolution; version read: arXiv text of 2611.05174 (sources/2611.05174.txt lines 1161-1167), arXiv text of 2008.07829 | Zhang & Li Eq. (1): H_J = J sum_<ij> S_i.S_j over nearest-neighbour kagome bonds, spin-1/2; the calculation 'is done on a L x L x 3 cluster with periodic - anti-periodic boundary condition' (Sec. III A), the spinon (mean-field) boundary condition of the Gutzwiller state, so the spin torus is the rhombic L x L x 3 one of the instance. 2611 Table II lists N = 3L^2 and E/N in units of J, S.S per site; no conversion. The number exists as a table entry only in 2611.05174; the producing paper prints it as a plotted point, which is not read (RULES.md 8). Row is secondary of Zhang & Li; the Z2 state of Table II is the optimized Z2[0,pi]beta RVB ansatz with up to third-neighbour bonds.
